title: LocalScript
summary: A client-side script: runs on each player's machine with access to their input, camera, and UI. Only runs in specific locations (StarterPlayer, StarterGui, ReplicatedStorage, workspace…) and cannot be trusted by the server.

properties.name: ResetOnSpawn
properties.description: Whether the LocalScript restarts each time the player's character respawns (relevant in StarterPlayer/StarterGui).

details.heading: Where LocalScripts run
details.body: Only in client-visible containers: StarterPlayerScripts, StarterCharacterScripts, StarterGui, StarterPack, ReplicatedStorage, ReplicatedFirst, workspace, and the Player objects. They do NOT run in ServerScriptService or ServerStorage (invisible to clients).

details.heading: Client-only APIs
details.body: Players.LocalPlayer, UserInputService, ContextActionService, RunService.RenderStepped, camera control, sounds played locally, TweenService on client-owned objects.

details.heading: Trust boundary
details.body: Everything a LocalScript does can be manipulated by exploiters. The server must independently validate any claim or action coming from clients.

explanation.whatItIs: Your game's eyes, ears, and hands on each player's machine. It's where UI reacts, cameras move, and input is captured.
explanation.whyItExists: Only the client knows when ITS player pressed a key, and only the client should render ITS screen. Server code can't do either.
whenToUse: GUI logic: buttons, HUD updates, menus
Sending validated intents to the server via remotes
whenNotToUse: Authoritative decisions (damage, currency, saving) — server's job
Code placed where LocalScripts don't run (ServerScriptService) — it simply won't execute
Storing anything secret — clients can read all client-reachable code
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
LocalScript runs when its container reaches the client:
  StarterGui / StarterPlayer → on spawn
  ReplicatedStorage           → as soon as replicated

LocalScript (client)              Script (server)
  detects input  ──FireServer──▶   validates + applies
  updates UI     ◀──FireClient──   authoritative result
```
tips: Keep one 'bootstrap' LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts that requires your client modules — easier to manage than many scattered LocalScripts
Use WaitForChild when reaching for replicated objects — they may arrive after your LocalScript starts
ResetOnSpawn matters for GUI scripts in StarterGui: false keeps state across respawns
commonMistakes: Putting a LocalScript in ServerScriptService/ServerStorage and wondering why it never runs
Trusting LocalScript state server-side (exploiters edit client memory)
Accessing workspace content immediately without WaitForChild — replication race
Forgetting LocalScripts run once PER PLAYER, on their machine — there is no shared client state between players

examples.title: Client input → server action
examples.code:
-- StarterPlayerScripts/InputHandler (LocalScript)
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local dashEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Dash")

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end   -- ignore when typing in chat etc.
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
        dashEvent:FireServer()     -- server decides if the dash is legal
    end
end)
examples.whyItWorks: Input only exists client-side, so detection happens here — but the ACTUAL dash (movement, cooldown) should be enforced by the server that receives FireServer.
